name: ILRS CRD Source
description: Read ILRS Consolidated Laser Ranging Data (CRD version 2) normal points into canonical SDS tracking data messages: LASER_RANGE observations per pass for analysis/estimation, with the epoch event as the time-tag reference and the pass's meteorology (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON between modules). read_crd takes the hostcap/http-request HttpResponse, BODY the CRD text verbatim, and writes one $TDM per pass plus one FlowNotice report (Info: COUNT the $TDM emitted, ITEMS the counters, the passes and every normal point's statistics as name=value). HTTP 304 gives one FlowNotice (Unchanged) and no $TDM; another status or a transport error is refused. Download and station coordinates belong to the SDN host flow; no hostcalls.

methods.displayName: Read CRD normal points as tracking data

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for one ILRS Consolidated Laser Ranging Data file, version 2 (normal point files such as EDC's npt_crd_v2 daily files): BODY the text verbatim, bounded to 64 MiB; STATUS 200, or 304 for unchanged.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for one ILRS Consolidated Laser Ranging Data file, version 2 (normal point files such as EDC's npt_crd_v2 daily files): BODY the text verbatim, bounded to 64 MiB; STATUS 200, or 304 for unchanged.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One canonical $TDM per pass: a segment per system configuration with LASER_RANGE observations (one-way range in metres, UTC epochs), and the pass's meteorological records as PRESSURE, TEMPERATURE and RHUMIDITY. analysis/estimation takes it on tracking_data.

outputPorts.description: One canonical $TDM per pass: a segment per system configuration with LASER_RANGE observations (one-way range in metres, UTC epochs), and the pass's meteorological records as PRESSURE, TEMPERATURE and RHUMIDITY. analysis/estimation takes it on tracking_data.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice (FNTC): KIND Info, SCHEMA TDM, SOURCE_NAME ilrs-crd, COUNT the $TDM emitted, ITEMS as name=value: format, sessions, passesRead, normalPointsInFile, normalPointsRead, meteorologicalRecords, speedOfLightMetresPerSecond, sessionsSkipped.<reason> (the sessions not read, by reason), unknownRecordType (one per type), per pass pass.<k>.station/sod/target/norad/start/normalPoints/configurations/epochEvent/meteorologicalRecords, and per normal point normalPoint.<k>.pass/epoch/timeOfFlightSeconds (as printed)/rawRanges/binRmsPs/windowSeconds/configuration (a statistic the record lacks has no item), from which a host takes the range's sigma; or KIND Unchanged (REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) for a 304.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice (FNTC): KIND Info, SCHEMA TDM, SOURCE_NAME ilrs-crd, COUNT the $TDM emitted, ITEMS as name=value: format, sessions, passesRead, normalPointsInFile, normalPointsRead, meteorologicalRecords, speedOfLightMetresPerSecond, sessionsSkipped.<reason> (the sessions not read, by reason), unknownRecordType (one per type), per pass pass.<k>.station/sod/target/norad/start/normalPoints/configurations/epochEvent/meteorologicalRecords, and per normal point normalPoint.<k>.pass/epoch/timeOfFlightSeconds (as printed)/rawRanges/binRmsPs/windowSeconds/configuration (a statistic the record lacks has no item), from which a host takes the range's sigma; or KIND Unchanged (REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) for a 304.

sequentialJustification.detail: One complete bounded data file is read in order into one record per pass and one FlowNotice; the host parallelizes independent files and this parser creates no threads.
